title: fix(app-shell): a marketplace-installed app's pending default permission set can be accepted from Studio and its marketplace page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDPccNbkwfqNxqEfoRgrEMK)_

Fixes #33158

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio「权限」页上的「开通 / 暂不」提示条，现在对只读软件包（市场装的应用都是只读）也显示；应用市场详情页对本环境已安装的应用，每次打开都显示这条提示，不再只在当次安装成功后出现一次。
- 为什么改：市场装的应用（比如 HotCRM）如果安装时没开通默认权限集，之后产品里没有任何界面能开通，受邀成员一直 403，业主只能直接调接口。
- 风险与回滚：只放开提示条这一处，「权限」页上其他编辑入口在只读包上照旧只读；没有 `manage_metadata` 的人列表照旧被拒、提示条不出现、也不报错。服务端与 spec 未改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里 `AccessPillar` 的 `SuggestedBindingsPanel` 挂载处；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 新增的 `installedSuggestions`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessSuggestionsReadOnly-33158.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installedSuggestions-33158.test.tsx`，预期 9 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：只放开提示条一处，其他只读入口不动；市场页复用同一个面板、不重复读取、不会出现两个面板；403 静默；两组消融各自变红，可以落地。

## What changes

**Studio Access pillar (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `AccessPillar`).** `SuggestedBindingsPanel` is no longer mounted under `!packageReadOnly`. Accepting or dismissing a suggested audience binding is a deployment decision about the package, not an edit of it, and the server already decides who may make it (`manage_metadata`, the anchor gates). A marketplace-installed package is read-only in Studio, and it is exactly the package that ships an `isDefault` set. The panel keeps reading `railPackageId` (the base's, as the pillar's comment says of the package-wide surfaces). No other `packageReadOnly` gate in the pillar is touched: the rail's "+ New", the matrix and every other affordance that edits the package stay read-only. The block is re-indented by one level because its wrapper went away; the props are unchanged.

**Marketplace package page (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`).** A new `installedSuggestions(manifestId, resultCarriesPanel)` draws the same `SuggestedBindingsPanel` (its own list read, no second fetcher) on every visit for a package installed here:

- installed here = a local install this runtime loaded (`localInstall` present and not `notLoaded`), or a cloud install into the environment this console renders (`cloudInstall`, which the page reads for that environment only: the hostname on a tenant runtime, `defaultEnvironmentId` on the control plane);
- not drawn while the install dialog is open (the dialog keeps its own served-install panel), nor while a local install's result banner carries its own panel, so one panel per package is on screen; it mounts again when either closes, and reads the list fresh;
- drawn in both page branches: the catalog page (`pkg.manifest_id`) and the marketplace-off page of a local install (`localInstall.manifestId`).

The panel draws pending, dismissed and accepted rows and renders nothing for a package without suggestions or for a refused list, so "whenever it has a pending, dismissed or confirmed suggestion" is the panel's own rule, unchanged. `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` is not changed: it already renders nothing on an empty list and on a 403.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/33158-suggested-bindings-read-only-installed.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, with both declaration lines.

No server change, no `packages/spec` change, no new i18n key.

## Tests

- `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessSuggestionsReadOnly-33158.test.tsx` (new; the REAL `AccessPillar` and `SuggestedBindingsPanel` over a metadata client double and a stub of `suggestedBindingsApi`):
  - a read-only package: a pending `crm_user` suggestion renders the strip with Accept and Dismiss (the Studio en labels), listed for the package;
  - CONTROL: a writable package renders the same strip;
  - CONTROL: the read-only package still has no rail "+ New"; the writable one does;
  - a list refused 403 renders no strip, no message and no error toast.
- `console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installedSuggestions-33158.test.tsx` (new; the REAL page and panel, marketplace calls and `suggestedBindingsApi` stubbed):
  - installed into this environment (cloud installation read answers installed), no install this session: a pending suggestion renders Accept and Dismiss, listed for the manifest id, one panel on screen;
  - a local install this runtime loaded: the same panel;
  - CONTROL: installed with no suggestion: nothing drawn;
  - CONTROL: not installed here: the list is never read and nothing is drawn;
  - a list refused 403: no panel, no message, no error toast.

Neither existing harness fitted: every existing Access pillar and marketplace page suite mocks `SuggestedBindingsPanel` away, so the pins sit in two new files beside them.

## Acceptance notes

- **Card acceptance 1 and 2** are pinned at the component level above (strip on a read-only package with Accept/Dismiss; no strip on a 403). The 「开通」 → member reads 200 and 「暂不」 → Reopen halves are the server's door and the panel's existing behaviour (`SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx`, unchanged and green); this PR adds no new action path.
- **Card acceptance 4 (staging re-read of cloud#3342 item b through the UI)** is not owed by this thread: it is the QA lane's, after this lands and staging picks it up.
- **Cloud follow-up, out of scope here:** the cloud 成员 page's 「去开通」 link (`TEAM_MEMBER_ACCESS_LINK`, cloud `service-tenant/src/pages/team.page.ts`) still lands on the Studio landing. Now that Studio → app → 权限 and the marketplace package page both carry the strip, that link can point closer. carrier: cloud.
- **Ruling hits in the surface** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): none inside the edited hunks. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` carries file-level hits elsewhere, and inside `AccessPillar` one (ruling `6053526025` question 1, on a draft-only set's rail label), untouched. `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`: one (ruling A on #27230, the credentials step), untouched. `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx`: none.
- **Not changed:** the install dialog's own panel (shown once the install is served) and the local install result banner's panel stay as they were; the page-level panel steps aside while either is up.

## Verification

Readings are on head `d8b78d0e` (objectstack `main` merged once) unless they say otherwise.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to HEAD and proved by blob hash, on f54d8ebb)</summary>

- Studio: the panel block wrapped back in the `!packageReadOnly` gate. `StudioDesignSurface.accessSuggestionsReadOnly-33158.test.tsx`: 3 failed, 1 passed. Red: the read-only strip pin, the read-only affordance CONTROL (it waits for the strip) and the 403 pin (the list is never read). Green: the writable CONTROL. A first attempt anchored only the opening tag, which left the JSX unbalanced: a transform error, no test ran, so it is not counted; the run above anchors the whole block.
- Marketplace: the page-level `installedSuggestions(pkg.manifest_id, …)` line deleted. `MarketplacePackagePage.installedSuggestions-33158.test.tsx`: 4 failed, 1 passed. Red: both installed pins, the no-suggestion CONTROL and the 403 pin (each waits for the list read). Green: the not-installed CONTROL.

Both suites import the source (`./StudioDesignSurface`, `../MarketplacePackagePage`), so no dist was involved.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests and type-check</summary>

- The two new files plus every `MarketplacePackagePage*` suite, every `StudioDesignSurface.access*` and `readOnly*` suite, `kernelReadOnly-29567`, `customizePublish-28562`, `oneSurface-28572` and `SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx`: Test Files 39 passed (39), Tests 340 passed (340). A run of the whole `views/studio-design/` directory (352 files) was stopped after 20 minutes under the shared lock and narrowed to the suites above; `Test UI` runs the rest in CI.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 36 commands, each run with stdin closed, all exit 0, `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` included. `--ran` reconciliation: "36 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The first pass, on the head before `d8b78d0e`, had `check:test-source-alias` red, asking for a module-top `@objectstack/lint` import in the Studio pin; the next commit adds it.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.
</details>
